title: Audit + merge or delete stale fix branches
description: The image-updater async-callback fix sat unmerged for 5 weeks (2026-09-05 to 2026-10-14) and was invisible to ArgoCD and alerts, which let the write storm incident recur. List all local+remote branches with commits not on main, classify each: merge it, rebase it, or delete it. Add a standing reminder: branches older than 2 weeks get surfaced weekly.
notes: All stale branches have explicit disposition; weekly reminder workflow live. Acceptance met.
acceptance_criteria: Every stale branch has an explicit disposition recorded (merged/rebased/deleted); a recurring reminder exists for branch age review.

comments.author: yuri
comments.text:
DISPOSITION (2026-10-15): Every branch classified; evidence = git cherry patchnew counts vs main.

MERGED TO MAIN (4): fix/noshow-gu..., pc01-kubelet-guardrails, obs-control-plane-tolerations, alert-rules-hygiene — merge commits df3fb0da, 6f0b84a3 + follow-ups; remote refs deleted.

REMOTE DELETED (34+): 29 empty-diff branches (patchnew=0; 15 had open PRs — closed first: 241,242,243,244,245,246,251,253,254,256,257,264,267,271) + 5 dead May-2026 renovate proposals with 1 stale patch each. Renovate pruned refs on PR close; our explicit deletes raced it (FAILs were phantom — refs verified gone via ls-remote).

REMOTE KEPT (12): after-this-its-k3s, bkp1, bkp-before-turing-pi, feat/from-strach, nixos, nix-version-full, old, pre-talos, rook-ceph, rpi (2024-2025 snapshot backups, user de facto archives) + renovate/configure, renovate/lock-file-maintenance (recurring renovate channels).

PRs LEFT OPEN (owner decision): #249 fix/pages-restart, #250 fix/pages-rollme, #260 ourtube/add-anunnaki-dreams (Yuri's own).

LOCAL DELETED (28): 17 patchnew=0 (card/*, cnpg-*, gcp-billing-relink-buzz-bucket, hermes-backup-token-audit, image-updater-args-fix, pi-agent-e415db3d, merged 4) + 11 superseded Nov-2025 renovate pins (kps-76/79, pg-16/18, mosquitto, zigbee2mqtt, tailscale-operator, istio-monorepo, ollama, kpetrem, argo-workflows-0.x, connect-2.x).

LOCAL KEPT: python (WIP), mainbkp, main-bkp-for-git-filter, renovate/configure, renovate/lock-file-maintenance + the snapshot backups above.

STANDING REMINDER: .github/workflows/branch-age-reminder.yaml (pushed with workflow commit) — weekly cron surfaces branches not on main and >14d old.
